summary: Daysog voted against Alameda's 2024 Gaza ceasefire letter, explicitly rejecting characterizations of Israel as an 'apartheid' or 'genocidal' state. In a 2026 questionnaire, he again opposed both the original and amended letters, rejected those descriptions, would oppose a West Bank sister-city relationship absent recognition of Israel's existence, and described confronting anti-Israel rhetoric in council. CAIR-SFBA's tracker records his opposition, noting it is not a verified roll-call transcript. A 2024 tension was noted between his vote and his campaign's 'peace' messaging.
